seasonseries.title: San Diego FC vs. Seattle Sounders FC

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
First Half ends, San Diego 0, Seattle Sounders FC 0.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Sebastian Gomez replaces Jesús Ferreira.
Second Half begins San Diego 0, Seattle Sounders FC 0.
Goal! San Diego 0, Seattle Sounders FC 1. Dejan Joveljic (Seattle Sounders FC) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Dejan Joveljic (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! San Diego 0, Seattle Sounders FC 2. Sebastian Gomez (Seattle Sounders FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Hassani Dotson.
Alex Roldan (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Anders Dreyer (San Diego) left footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Andrew Thomas (Seattle Sounders FC).
Goal! San Diego 1, Seattle Sounders FC 2. Cédric Bakambu (San Diego) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Substitution, San Diego. Jeppe Tverskov replaces Alejandro Alvarado.
Substitution, San Diego. Marcus Ingvartsen replaces Amahl Pellegrino.
Substitution, San Diego. Onni Valakari replaces Aníbal Godoy.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Stuart Hawkins replaces Alex Roldan.
